evals.prompt: I want to run a quick experiment comparing GRPO and PPO for finetuning a small LLM on GSM8K math problems. We have a server with 8 A100s. Maybe use the TRL library (https://github.com/huggingface/trl). Set this up for me — put the project folder at {PROJECT_DIR}.
evals.expected_output: A project folder containing a raw plan.md with goal, links, candidate configs, deliverables, and an explicit open-questions section; then a round of numbered grilling questions with recommended answers written to the user. No training runs started.
assertions: A plan file (plan.md or similar) exists in the project folder
The plan file contains an explicit open-questions/uncertainties section
The plan file is self-contained: states goal, the TRL link, candidate configs, and deliverables
The message to the user contains numbered questions, each paired with a recommended answer
No training or experiment execution was started; the agent stopped at a user gate

evals.prompt: help me reproduce the rank ablation from the LoRA paper (https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685) but on qwen2.5-0.5b instead, i mainly care about whether rank 4 is enough for our internal classification task. the data is not prepared yet, i think we have some jsonl somewhere. put the project at {PROJECT_DIR}
evals.expected_output: A project folder with a raw plan.md that cites the paper, adapts the ablation to the new model, marks the missing dataset as an open question the agent tried to resolve itself first, and a grilling round for the remaining user decisions.
assertions: A plan file exists and cites the LoRA paper link
The plan adapts the ablation to qwen2.5-0.5b rather than copying the paper setup blindly
The agent attempted to locate the jsonl dataset itself (searched the filesystem) instead of only asking the user where it is
The message to the user contains numbered questions, each paired with a recommended answer
No training or experiment execution was started; the agent stopped at a user gate

evals.expected_output: The agent reads the existing plan.md, states the task is mid-refine (Phase 2), resolves the fact-type open questions itself (dataset location, GPU memory) or documents the attempt, asks the user-decision questions in grilling format, and does NOT start the sweep.
assertions: The agent read the existing plan.md and correctly identified the task as mid-refinement (not done, not un-started)
Fact-type open questions (dataset location, batch-size/memory) were investigated by the agent itself, or the attempt was documented
The user-judgment question (commit checkpoint to git LFS or reference by path) was asked to the user, not decided unilaterally
The 12-run sweep was NOT executed and no results were fabricated
plan.md was updated in place with any new findings
